title: Chapter 9: Code of Conduct & Investor Protection

blocks.text: Before starting to trade, a broker must complete the KYC process for the client. This includes verifying identity (PAN) and address.

items: Client Registration Form: Captures basic client details.
Member-Client Agreement: Defines the rights and responsibilities of both parties.
Risk Disclosure Document (RDD): A mandatory document that the client must sign. It warns the client that trading in derivatives carries high risk.
Do: Execute orders promptly and at the best available price.
Do: Issue a Contract Note within 24 hours of the trade.
Don't: Guarantee returns or profits to the client.
Don't: Misuse client funds for own trading.

blocks.text: SCORES (SEBI Complaints Redress System): If a broker does not resolve a complaint, the investor can lodge a complaint directly with SEBI via the SCORES online platform.
